profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
Seasoned Senior Software Engineer with a passion for full stack development, I specialize in delivering exceptional web experiences that prioritize accessibility, privacy, and security. I have a strong background in React JS, Typescript, JavaScript, C#, and Kusto Query Language, with a proven track record of delivering quality software solutions that meet and exceed customer expectations.

In addition to my technical expertise, I have shown exceptional leadership and the ability to drive project development. I am also committed to providing mentorship and guidance to junior team members, helping to foster an environment of growth and learning.

Throughout my career, I have been passionate about staying up to date with emerging technologies and trends. My love for learning has driven me to take on new challenges, resulting in continuous professional growth. I am dedicated to delivering quality software solutions that provide tangible value to customers while providing excellent customer support.

My unique blend of technical expertise, leadership skills, and passion for full stack development makes me a valuable asset to any team. Whether working independently or collaboratively, I am committed to delivering exceptional results while maintaining a positive attitude and strong work ethic.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Power Automate, Cloud Flows
positions.description:
React/JavaScript/Typescript/C#/Kusto/JSON/CSS
Contributing to the mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to do more through automation. Learn more at https://powerautomate.microsoft.com

Acting as support champion in the team. Drove 60% reduction of active support tickets and improved response rate in the team.

positions.title: Software Engineer II, Microsoft Feedback, Microsoft 365 Customer Success Engineering
positions.description:
Feedback Portal (https://feedbackportal.microsoft.com)
React/JavaScript/Typescript/Microsoft Dynamics/Kusto/JSON/CSS
Contributed to the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Service Community code base to release the Feedback Portal where M365 users can interact with the feedback data they provide to Microsoft and the public data that is sent by other M365 users.
Participated in Privacy, Security and Compliance conversations and reviews to ensure we deliver the best experience to our users.

Product feedback view in Microsoft 365 admin center
React/JavaScript/Typescript/Kusto/JSON/XML/CSS
Developed and released a new experience in the Microsoft 365 admin center where administrators can interact with the feedback data for their organizations.
Enabled telemetry and constructed a dashboard using Lens Explorer and Kusto to understand usage, reliability and performance of this view.

positions.title: Software Engineer II, Windows Feedback, Windows Fundamentals
positions.description:
Internal triage website
C#/Elasticsearch/React/JavaScript/Azure Application Insights/Kusto/JSON/CSS
Full stack development of an internal website where users can triage Windows feedback data that comes from multiple sources.
Enabled telemetry and constructed a dashboard using Azure Application Insights and Kusto to understand usage of this website.

Internal website
C#/Elasticsearch/JavaScript/JSON/CSS
Full stack development of an internal website where users can perform exploratory data analysis of Windows feedback data that comes from Feedback Hub app.

positions.title: Software Consultant
positions.description:

Organized, coordinated and planned project development.

Led and supervised software development.

Drafted software solutions.

Tested software and analyzed errors.
